verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph (which underlies Teams APIs) shows clear versioning in its endpoints (e.g., 'graph-rest-1.0' in docs, live v1.0 metadata schema at ms-teams-probe-5) and OAuth-gated, machine-readable schema, indicating a stable versioned API surface. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documented deprecation policy or lifecycle guarantees, and community feedback notes API integration complexity (ms-teams-comm-11), leaving deprecation practices unverified.
